# Dr. Emmanuel A. Owolabi

> Official profile of Dr. Emmanuel A. Owolabi, a physician, health innovator and 2026 Diana Award recipient working across technology, research, education and leadership to turn complex healthcare challenges into practical action.

## About

Dr. Emmanuel A. Owolabi works across health innovation, digital health, health literacy, public health communication, medical education, research capacity development and healthcare leadership, with a focus on practical solutions for African healthcare.

He is a 2026 Diana Award recipient. The award announcement and recognition are described on the official profile and illustrated in its recognition section.

## Selected work

- EOhealth develops accessible health information and practical responses to healthcare challenges: <https://eohealthhub.com>
- ViHLERT (Virtual Health Literacy and Emergency Response Training) provides health literacy, communication, advocacy and emergency-response training: <https://vihlert.eohealthhub.com>
- This website describes work in mentorship, research capacity development, healthcare education and institution building.
